scope: Earlier archived marker and wearable measurements for the same 1,060 five-degree fitting cases. Person-disjoint evaluation folds within the admitted development cohort. No 10° outcomes were used.

methods.label: Static body weight on the slope
Mechanical estimate from projected pelvis acceleration

motion_inputs.wearable_units: m/s², verified against the authors’ matching time and values
motion_inputs.optical_geometry: Same two anterior pelvis markers for every person. One fitting trial had no posterior marker coordinates. Optical points are a geometrical proxy, with physical availability and possible preprocessing unresolved.
